component.name: Backup
component.summary: Back up your files to your own drive and get them back

description.p: Backup keeps encrypted copies of your files on an external drive of your own. Every day it backs up your home folder, Mail, Calendar, People and Tasks, and your app settings, and it catches up when you plug the drive back in after a missed backup.

Pick any backup by date to browse it, search it, and put files back where they were or in a folder you choose. Old backups are thinned out over a year, oldest first when the drive is nearly full. The password is made for you and kept in your keyring. Nothing leaves the PC: no cloud and no network.
